Provide complete and accurate project handoffs to Estimators.

Experience in project coordination, customer service, estimating support, administrative coordination, or a similar role in the signage or graphics industry.

jobs.description:
Location: Casper, WY/Laramie, WY/Salt Lake City, UT/Idaho Falls, ID (With Travel)

Title: Natural Resources Field Technician Lead

Schedule (FT/PT): Temporary Full Time

Travel Required: Yes (75-100%)

Government Clearance: Ability to Obtain

Incorporated in 2011, North Wind Resource Consulting’s core capabilities include environmental documentation and permitting; natural and cultural resource surveys; wildlife and botanical expertise; National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA) technical services; historic and prehistoric surveys; environmental consultation such as Section 106 for cultural resources, Section 404 for wetlands, and Section 7 for endangered species); and Geographic Information Systems (GIS) and mapping capabilities. North Wind Resource Consulting maintains offices across the country.

Position Purpose

We are seeking proactive, self-reliant, problem solvers to lead a two-person team as a Natural Resources Field Technician Lead. This field-based position requires someone who is comfortable in remote environments, adapts to dynamic conditions, and demonstrates sound decision-making in challenging situations without constant supervision. This person will be responsible for ensuring accurate daily data collection, leading by example in adhering to safety protocols, and maintaining a strong work ethic.

Fieldwork takes place outdoors where weather and terrain can be demanding. Field teams generally work 10-to-12-hour days with an 8 days on/ 6 days off schedule. This role requires self-motivation, initiative, and the ability to work effectively within a two-person team and coordinate with other teams. The position will report to a Project Manager located in Idaho Falls, Idaho; however, the field technician may be stationed near the survey area. The position is expected to run until mid-to-end October 2026, with potential opportunities for extension based on performance and project needs.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Lead a team of 2 – 3 Range Technicians in data collection and field sampling assignments.
Coordinate daily field operations with other leads stationed in the same area.
Independently address challenges in the field and adapt plans as necessary to ensure safety and data quality.
Execute and enforce established field protocols for vegetation sampling and data collection (including species inventory, foliar cover, canopy gap, species abundance, and herbaceous and woody heights).
Provide guidance to team members on the collection and maintenance of field data.
Take accountability for the accuracy, completeness, and organization of collected data and photos, ensuring they are properly entered, reviewed, and uploaded to the proper channels in a timely manner.
Safely navigate off-trail and operate 4WD vehicles on remote, unmaintained roads.
Ensure proper care and maintenance of all equipment, including vehicles, to avoid unnecessary damage or loss.
Perform qualitative range assessments, collect photo points, and conduct extensive QA/QC checks on collected data and photos.
Dig soil pits to characterize and describe soil horizons and correlate sites with ecological site descriptions (ESDs).
Utilize handheld units for data collection, and upload photos to the NRCS server.
Maintain regular communication with project management, support staff and NRCS range staff.

Additional Duties And Responsibilities

Assist with logistical planning and preparation for field hitches (including but not limited to booking hotel rooms, ensuring vehicles and equipment are maintained, coordinating travel schedules with other teams).
Prepare materials such as maps and equipment for field assignments.

Minimum Qualifications

Education and Experience:

Bachelor’s Degree in botany, rangeland science, biology, natural resource management, soils, ecology, or closely related field. Alternatively
, candidates actively working towards a degree in one of these fields may be considered if they have relevant coursework (e.g., plant identification, natural resources, etc.) and/or prior experience in vegetation sampling, soil characterization, or related outdoor fieldwork.

Skills And Abilities

Demonstrated aptitude in areas such as leadership, problem-solving, and working in remote, outdoor environments
Ability to lead a team and be entrusted with autonomy to make critical decisions in the field
Quick learner with a strong work ethic and a proactive approach to challenges
Detail-oriented and take pride in producing high-quality work
Ability to work independently, adapt to unforeseen challenges, and make safe, intelligent decisions in a remote setting
Clear communication skills and the ability to provide guidance to entry-level technicians
Familiarity with vegetation and soil survey techniques
Ability to navigate effectively with maps, GPS devices, and offroad vehicles
Willingness and ability to consistently enact high performance standards in support of the goals and objectives of the NRI program and North Wind’s commitment to providing the NRCS with the highest quality data.

Special Requirements

Ability to travel and work a rotating schedule of 8 days on and 6 days off with overtime
Valid driver’s license and experience safely operating 4WD trucks on paved and unpaved roads, often in remote, rugged terrain.
Must be able to pass a pre-employment drug test and background check.

Preferred Qualifications

3 years of relevant experience demonstrating proficiency in the previously listed skills and abilities
Familiarity with NRCS's National Resources Inventory (NRI) methodology and/or BLM's Assessment, Inventory, and Monitoring (AIM) protocols is strongly desired
Experience identifying plants using a dichotomous key and describing soil horizons
CPR/First Aid certified

Physical Demands

Ability to walk long distances (up to several miles per day) over rugged and uneven terrain while maintaining an efficient pace to meet project deadlines and team productivity standards
Must have the physical stamina to work outdoors for extended hours, often in challenging hot or cold weather conditions, and carry equipment and supplies weighing up to 30 pounds

Working Environment

Extended travel and outdoor fieldwork in remote, rugged environments
Long drives in company vehicles to access survey locations, often traveling between remote areas, hotels, and project sites on both paved and unpaved roads. Drive times can vary depending on project location and where the employee is stationed.

Western Rock Products, is A CRH Company. Our purpose, commitment to the future, and formula for growth is to champion the safety, empowerment, and development of our employees. We strive to be The Preferred Source of quality sand, rock, landscape products, ready-mixed concrete, asphalt, paving and construction services. Position Overview

The Geologist/Mining Engineer is responsible for developing long term reserves of quality stone, sand and gravel throughout Central and Southern Utah. The position is responsible for supporting all aggregate plant operations within Central and Southern Utah by clearly defining strategies to improve Life of Mining (LOM) and extend quarry reserves. Ideally this position will be based in St. George, Utah. However, it could be based at any of our operations in Central & Southern Utah (this would require additional travel).

Key Responsibilities (Essential Duties And Functions)

Strategic Land Acquisitions

Identify, secure, and develop high quality aggregate reserves for our hot mix asphalt, ready mix concrete, and construction operations.
Build effective working relationships with State and Federal agencies, local geologists, mining engineers and non-competitive mining companies to secure ownership of or rights to high quality aggregates.
Assist with technical evaluations and assessments including, but not limited to, geologic modeling, drilling and exploration, reserves assessment, and mine planning.
Liaise and negotiate on mineral-related matters with State and Federal agencies, academic institutions, the industry, and represent the company on committees, boards, industry bodies, and other relevant organizations as required.

Mine Plan Management

Will work closely with production managers to develop and maintain short, intermediate, and long-term LOM plans to achieve maximum value through the optimum utilization of all resources and reserves.
Work with General Managers, Plant Managers and quarry personnel to develop key performance indicators as it relates to optimizing quarry reserves, minimizing waste streams and lowering mining costs.
Maintain 3D Geologic Models of quarries utilizing Carlson software.

Conduct regular geotechnical surveys to identify, mitigate and resolve hazards.

Working knowledge in assessing LOM resource and reserves, pit designs, development of 5-year block models for quarry mining to include effective water drainage control and overburden removal.

The Work

MyChoice Training is seeking a Data Analyst who can turn organized business data into clear findings that support practical decisions. The role combines careful data preparation, recurring reporting, and focused analysis of trends, exceptions, and performance measures.

Reporting quality also depends on consistency over time. When a recurring measure changes definition, source, or calculation logic, you should document the change and help ensure future comparisons are interpreted correctly rather than treating unlike figures as directly comparable.

The role includes both recurring and ad hoc work. Some assignments will follow established reporting cycles, while others will require you to investigate a new question, compare multiple sources, or test whether a surprising result reflects a true change or a data-quality issue.

Responsibilities

Create visualizations that make patterns, differences, and exceptions easier for stakeholders to interpret.
Use SQL, spreadsheets, and analytical tools to filter, compare, reconcile, and interpret information.
Communicate findings in straightforward business language and distinguish evidence from assumptions.
Validate figures before distribution and investigate discrepancies instead of passing uncertain results forward.
Identify missing values, duplicates, inconsistent definitions, and other data-quality concerns.
Prepare recurring reports, dashboards, tables, and summaries for stakeholder review.

Candidate Profile

Comfort working with numbers, structured datasets, percentages, trends, and common performance measures.
Ability to organize priorities independently while collaborating through shared digital tools in a remote setting.
Curiosity and sound judgment when a result looks inconsistent with expectations or prior information.
Clear written communication and an organized approach to analytical documentation.
Willingness to document work carefully and ask focused questions when requirements or source data are unclear.

Visualization is part of the communication process, not a substitute for analysis. Charts and dashboards should emphasize the relevant pattern, use appropriate comparisons, and avoid presentation choices that make the result appear more certain or dramatic than the underlying data supports.

Over time, you will become more familiar with recurring measures and reporting needs, creating opportunities to make analyses more efficient while preserving the checks that keep results dependable.

You will work remotely from within the United States and collaborate through common digital workplace tools. The expectation is professional communication, responsible time management, and consistent ownership of assigned work from initial request through completion.

The Work

MyChoice Training is seeking a Data Analyst who can turn organized business data into clear findings that support practical decisions. The role combines careful data preparation, recurring reporting, and focused analysis of trends, exceptions, and performance measures.

Reporting quality also depends on consistency over time. When a recurring measure changes definition, source, or calculation logic, you should document the change and help ensure future comparisons are interpreted correctly rather than treating unlike figures as directly comparable.

The role includes both recurring and ad hoc work. Some assignments will follow established reporting cycles, while others will require you to investigate a new question, compare multiple sources, or test whether a surprising result reflects a true change or a data-quality issue.

Responsibilities

Create visualizations that make patterns, differences, and exceptions easier for stakeholders to interpret.
Use SQL, spreadsheets, and analytical tools to filter, compare, reconcile, and interpret information.
Communicate findings in straightforward business language and distinguish evidence from assumptions.
Validate figures before distribution and investigate discrepancies instead of passing uncertain results forward.

Prepare recurring reports, dashboards, tables, and summaries for stakeholder review.

Candidate Profile

Comfort working with numbers, structured datasets, percentages, trends, and common performance measures.
Ability to organize priorities independently while collaborating through shared digital tools in a remote setting.
Curiosity and sound judgment when a result looks inconsistent with expectations or prior information.
Clear written communication and an organized approach to analytical documentation.
Willingness to document work carefully and ask focused questions when requirements or source data are unclear.

Visualization is part of the communication process, not a substitute for analysis. Charts and dashboards should emphasize the relevant pattern, use appropriate comparisons, and avoid presentation choices that make the result appear more certain or dramatic than the underlying data supports.

Over time, you will become more familiar with recurring measures and reporting needs, creating opportunities to make analyses more efficient while preserving the checks that keep results dependable.
